newsitem.title: USA: Krantor says on track for Q1 profitability.
newsitem.headline: Krantor says on track for Q1 profitability.

text.p: Krantor Corp said Wednesday it is confident that its operating businesss continues to be on track for a profitable second quarter.

Krantor said it knows of no reason for the company's common stock to be declining other than "the normal decline that is frequently exhibited following a reverse split." The recent "D" placed on the company's NASDAQ symbol because of the split is scheduled to be removed on May 30, 1997.

Mair Faibish, executive vice president of Krantor said that in a few weeks the company expects to make an announcement regarding the resumption of business with a major grocery and health and beauty aid supplier.
Krantor Corp. recently reported two consecutive quarters of profitability from operations, marking the beginning of its turnaround.

The company expects to meet or exceed its first quarter earnings from operations in the second quarter. After reflecting the reverse split, total earnings for the first quarter were $0.23 per share of which $0.08 per share were from continuing operations.
